description:
List what each provider supports, from sending media to interactive replies, and what still blocks a feature: a permission, a webhook field, or a provider approval. Check this before telling the coach a channel can do something.

Luca operation: GET /api/channels/features
Required scopes: channels:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: redacted
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
